summary: Full E2E frontend testing of new 'Retrato de realeza' portrait flow at mobile viewport 390x844. All 8 required scenarios passed: landing choice cards navigate correctly, step 1 blocks advance without photo (toast 'Sube una foto de tu mascota'), photo upload + optional name works, step 2 style selection + gift toggle + gift fields work, progress screen polls and transitions, result screen shows watermarked preview with paywall + dedication, demo pay-button instantly unlocks share hub with HD image + download/share/copy, gift link /r/<slug> shows wrapped reveal then dedication + CTA, story flow regression at /crear still loads pet-name-input.

issues: Portrait image inside gift reveal occasionally renders slowly / appears gray before load completes; consider skeleton/blur-up to avoid blank frame perception. Not functional, just UX polish.

critical_code_review_comments: Portrait.jsx cfgRetention() hardcodes 7 days but config may expose portrait_retention; consider wiring from cfg.
StepProgress has no timeout cap in UI — if backend stalls, user is stuck forever. Consider surfacing a 'Está tomando más de lo normal' hint after e.g. 120s.
Image download in StepResult uses fetch + blob which may face CORS issues in production if media host differs; current same-origin via /api/media works but worth noting.
Portrait.jsx is ~390 lines in a single file with 4 sub-components; within budget but close — split if more steps are added.
seed_data_creation: Created a dummy /tmp/pet.jpg (600x800 solid color) for upload. Real portrait generated via fal.ai in ~30-60s.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Portrait flow is stable end-to-end on mobile viewport. Clipboard-based slug capture works for /r/<slug>. Backend media served at /api/media/<id>/preview.jpg and clean_*.jpg. Generation uses real fal.ai so allow ~60-120s on StepProgress.
